verification_scope: Applicable editions/amendments; Indian supplemental requirements; authority interpretation/report wording
review_notes: Applicable OIML R 76-1:2006 and R 76-2:2007 source editions were reviewed together with the controlled Indian Legal Metrology source families. Principal rules applicable amendments and corrigenda represented in the reviewed source set were considered in establishing the regulatory baseline. No candidate source identity was accepted solely from implementation metadata.

Accuracy-class determination and the relationships involving Min Max verification scale interval e actual scale interval d and number of verification scale intervals n were reviewed against the controlled OIML R 76-1:2006 source. The register is considered resolved only to the extent reflected in the verified rule mappings completed later in this review pack.

verification_scope: MPE tables, boundaries, digital/analog error semantics and rounding exceptions
review_notes: Maximum permissible error tables applicable load boundaries and error-determination semantics were reviewed against the controlled OIML R 76-1 and R 76-2 sources. Exact executable thresholds and calculation policies remain traceable to the reviewed rule and executable-rule records.

verification_scope: Section 1 exact procedure and load coverage
review_notes: The Section 1 weighing-performance procedure required load coverage observation sequence and acceptance basis were reviewed against the controlled OIML sources. The verified implementation mapping is recorded in the corresponding test and executable-rule review records.

Temperature-test conditions observation requirements and acceptance criteria were reviewed against the controlled OIML R 76 sources. Implementation-specific procedure/schema selections are reviewed separately in the runtime-schema review.

Eccentricity test variants load placement geometry applicable test load and acceptance requirements were reviewed against the controlled OIML sources. Applicable geometry and evaluator policy are traceable to the reviewed rule records.

Discrimination and sensitivity requirements including applicable additional loads indication response and acceptance criteria were reviewed against the controlled OIML sources and treated as distinct regulatory test concepts where required.

Repeatability procedure repetition requirements applicable loading conditions and acceptance calculation were reviewed against the controlled OIML sources. The executable calculation policy is separately traceable in the rule review.
Zero-return and creep/time-dependence requirements including observation timing loading conditions and acceptance criteria were reviewed against the controlled OIML sources.

Stability-of-equilibrium requirements timing conditions and acceptance criteria were reviewed against the controlled OIML sources. The corresponding evaluator schema and rule mapping are reviewed separately.
Tilting-test orientation tilt magnitude operating conditions and acceptance criteria were reviewed against the controlled OIML sources.

verification_scope: Sections 9-11 tare, warm-up and voltage variation
review_notes: Tare operation warm-up behaviour and voltage-variation procedures and acceptance criteria were independently reviewed against the controlled OIML sources. Each implemented evaluator remains subject to its corresponding runtime and executable-rule review.

verification_scope: Section 12 disturbance severity/procedure and external standards
review_notes: Section 12 disturbance requirements severity levels test procedures and the normatively referenced external standards required for the reviewed scope were independently reviewed against the controlled evidence set. The applicable disturbance-test requirements and their regulatory basis were confirmed for the reviewed implementation scope.
Damp-heat span-stability and endurance procedures exposure conditions observation requirements and acceptance criteria were reviewed against the controlled OIML sources.

Construction examination and checklist requirements were reviewed against the controlled OIML sources. Each checklist item's verified wording applicability and evidence requirement is separately recorded in 05_checklist_review.csv.

Requirements concerning test equipment suitability/calibration environmental recording supporting evidence and retest traceability were reviewed against the controlled OIML material and the review-governance requirements of the evaluation workflow. Any implementation policy that exceeds explicit regulatory text is treated as controlled laboratory/software governance rather than attributed to OIML.

OIML R 76-2 report-format requirements and the applicable Indian Legal Metrology requirements concerning report authority issue signature revision and retention were reviewed against the controlled evidence set and the identified laboratory/authority governance for the reviewed deployment context. The applicable report-governance requirements were resolved for this review scope.
